summary: In Stranglethorn Vale, Barnil needs the scattered chapters of Master Nesingwary’s manuscript gathered and put back in order. Chapter IV is one of the four pieces needed to complete the book.

sections.title: Scattered Pages
sections.body: A gust tore through Master Nesingwary’s camp and scattered pages from his novel across the jungle. Barnil gathered most of them, but the missing pages still need to be collected and arranged into four chapters. Chapter IV belongs with the other three before the manuscript can be returned to Barnil.

faq.answer: Chapter IV is one of the four chapters of Master Nesingwary’s novel, The Green Hills of Stranglethorn.
Barnil is gathering the chapters of Master Nesingwary’s manuscript and asks for them once all four are complete.
A large gust of wind blew through Master Nesingwary’s camp and scattered pages from his manuscript around the jungle.

faq.q: What is The Green Hills of Stranglethorn about?
faq.answer: It is a novel by Master Nesingwary. The gathered chapters are meant to complete its manuscript.
